title: A Type Checker Stub
description: A starter class for the type-checking extension in Stage 6. It subclasses Evaluator and leaves the body empty, marking where a pre-evaluation pass would go.

steps.description: This is a starter class for a type checker, one of the extension ideas in Stage 6. The page calls type checking a pre-evaluation pass: instead of values, it carries types, so it catches type errors before running.
`class TypeChecker(Evaluator)` subclasses `Evaluator`, so it can reuse the evaluator's structure while changing what it carries.
The docstring states the idea: carry types instead of values, replace int values with the string `Int` and bool values with `Bool`, and catch type errors before running.
`pass` leaves the body empty. The class is a sketch of where to start, not a working checker.
